messages:
chen: ran a few long traces against mistral-7b on the new kernel selector. seeing a weird perf cliff when seq_len crosses ~2048. attaching quick paste of the flame:
chen: ```
flame: kernel_select -> tile_split -> kv_load -> attn_forward
hot: attn_forward (avg ms/token = 1.8 before 2048, 3.9 after)
``` 
alex: hm that's a big step. do you see different kernels being chosen? selector logs?
chen: yes. before 2048 it picks fp16 fused-attn-v2, after it falls back to split-attn-tiling (fp32 path). selector reasons are "tile_overflow" + "rope_scale_mismatch" in the debug flags.
maria: rope_scale_mismatch? we should be clamping max_pos or using dynamic RoPE scaling in the kernel chooser. did model config set max_position_embeddings to 4096 or 2048?
chen: model has max_position_embeddings=4096 but runtime was defaulting to 2048 window in the sliding-window prefetcher. so when request position > 2048 the kernel selector treats it like a different memory layout.
sasha: that mismatch rings a bell — we added an optimization that assumed maxpos==runtime_window and avoided reordering KV tiles. if runtime_window < model_maxpos, the kernel fingerprints diverge and we hit fallback. ticket-wise this is similar to #IR-834 but not identical.
alex: quick idea: rather than forcing full recompile, can batcher inject a synthetic "lookahead" metadata to force the selector to pick the fused-attn path (if capacity allows)? basically advertise seq_distribution with higher tail so kernel choice stays stable.
maria: yes but that can increase memory pressure. maybe better to adapt the prefetcher: extend sliding-window prefetch to precompute rope_scale factor when max_position_embeddings != runtime_window and annotate KV tiles with scaled_rope tag.
chen: prototyped a naive change: when model.maxpos > window we set tile.meta = {scaled_rope: true} and keep fused kernel if GPU mem after adding 8% margin. measured: throughput drop removed, latency stable, tokens/sec +12% on long sequences.
infra-bot: deploy queued: runtime-canary-2026-03-18 -> eng-runtime -> started
sasha: nice. can you paste the small diff you used? a 3-5 line change is preferred for canary.
chen: diff snippet:
chen: ```
if (model.maxpos > window) tile.meta.scaled_rope = true;
// kernel_selector: treat scaled_rope tiles as compatible with fused-attn-v2
if (tile.meta.scaled_rope && mem_margin_ok()) pick(fused_attn_v2);
```
maria: let's add a guard: only apply scaled_rope for head_dim divisible kernels (to avoid precision blowup). add telemetry tag so we can see how often we hit scaled_rope in canary.
alex: agree. also add a cooldown in batching heuristics: if a request triggers scaled_rope, don't let subsequent short requests force a kernel reselect for 100ms.
chen: will open a small PR with telemetry and cooldown. will canary by EOD.
sasha: thanks — if canary looks good, we should backport to the dedicated runtime patch as well. :thumbsup
